_comment: Shared cross-SDK normalized-definition parity. Equivalent Python and TypeScript scorer definitions must produce the SAME normalized descriptor fields below -- identity, policy, AND the config-hash `version`. The version is derived from the judge's declarative config through the shared canonicalizer (snake_case keys, sha256), so it changes when the rubric changes and NEVER when the authoring language changes. Provenance (language/source) stays language-specific.

judge_with_metadata._comment: metadata exercises the canonicalizer inside the config hash: numeric-string keys, an integral float, an exponent-threshold float.
